title: Marvel Universe
premise: Mutants, super-soldiers, gods, and geniuses share one world. The Avengers try to hold it together. Not everyone agrees on how.

lore.title: New York City
lore.text: Manhattan skyline where most superhuman brawls end up. Avengers Tower rises over Midtown, and the Sanctum Sanctorum hides in Greenwich Village. Cops, crowds, and collateral damage are a daily fact of life.

lore.title: Avengers Tower
lore.text: Stark-built headquarters on the East River in Midtown Manhattan. Holds training floors, a secure operations deck, and a lab wing. Doubles as a target whenever villains want to send a message.

lore.title: Xavier's School
lore.text: Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters sits on a Westchester estate outside New York City. Professor X trains mutant teens to control their powers and survive a world that fears them. Cerebro stays hidden beneath the grounds.

lore.title: Wakanda
lore.text: Hidden African kingdom powered by vibranium deposits in its mountains. Its technology runs decades ahead of the rest of the world, and a cloaking field keeps outsiders from ever finding it. Ruled by the Black Panther.

lore.title: Asgard
lore.text: Realm of the Asgardian gods, floating above the cosmos and linked to Earth by the Bifrost bridge. Home of Odin, Thor, and the Golden Hall. Its warriors guard the Nine Realms against cosmic threats.

lore.title: The Avengers
lore.text: Earth's mightiest heroes, assembled to stop Loki and never fully disbanded since. The roster shifts constantly. They handle threats no single nation can, and they fight constantly over who gets to decide what counts as a threat.

lore.title: SHIELD
lore.text: Strategic Hazard Intervention, Espionage and Logistics Directorate. Government espionage and peacekeeping agency run by Nick Fury for decades. Its leadership has been infiltrated more than once, including by HYDRA.

lore.title: HYDRA
lore.text: Nazi-born secret society that survived World War II by going underground and infiltrating governments and corporations. Its agents have shaped conflicts across the globe for decades. Its symbol is the stylized octopus.

lore.title: Stark Industries
lore.text: Weapons and technology conglomerate founded by Howard Stark. Now run by Tony Stark, who pivoted it toward clean energy after decades of arms contracts. Its tech powers the Iron Man armor and still draws rivals and thieves.

lore.title: The Mutant Gene
lore.text: The X-gene is a genetic mutation found in a small slice of humanity, usually manifesting at puberty. It produces powers ranging from telepathy to a healing factor. Its existence split governments and communities into protectors and hunters.

lore.title: The Infinity Stones
lore.text: Six cosmic artifacts holding power over space, mind, reality, power, soul, and time. Scattered across the universe, they have been sought by gods, tyrants, and heroes alike. Whoever gathers all six can wipe out half of all life.

lore.title: The Super-Soldier Serum
lore.text: Formula developed in 1940s America by Dr. Abraham Erskine that turned Steve Rogers into Captain America. The original formula died with Erskine, and every attempt to recreate it has produced side effects or failures. Militaries and HYDRA both still want it.

lore.title: The Superhuman Registration Act
lore.text: Federal law passed after a catastrophic clash in Stamford, Connecticut that forced all costumed heroes to register with the government. The act split heroes into pro- and anti-registration camps and led to open war between former allies.

lore.title: Spider-Man
lore.text: Peter Parker, a teenage Queens science student bitten by a radioactive spider. Balances web-slinging through New York with rent, exams, and the Daily Bugle's smears. Super strength, agility, and a spider-sense that screams before trouble arrives.

lore.title: Iron Man
lore.text: Tony Stark, billionaire inventor and head of Stark Industries. Wears a powered armor suit he built after being wounded in an ambush overseas. A founding Avenger who pushes technology further than anyone, often in directions his teammates wish he would not.

lore.title: Captain America
lore.text: Steve Rogers, super-soldier frozen in ice for decades and revived in the modern era. The moral center of the Avengers and a symbol of American ideals, who keeps fighting for the people he believes in even when his government disagrees.

lore.title: Thanos
lore.text: Titan warlord obsessed with balance and death. Gathers the Infinity Stones to wipe out half of all life in the universe, believing the survivors will live better. Armed with the Infinity Gauntlet, he has come close to success more than once.

lore.title: Wolverine
lore.text: Logan, Canadian mutant with retractable adamantium claws and a healing factor that has kept him alive through nearly every wound imaginable. Trained by the Weapon X program, he is ferocious, guarded, and fiercely loyal to the X-Men.

lore.title: Professor X
lore.text: Charles Xavier, telepath and founder of Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters. Leads the X-Men and argues for coexistence between humans and mutants. Runs the Cerebro network that tracks mutants across the planet.

lore.title: Magneto
lore.text: Erik Lehnsherr, Holocaust survivor and master of magnetism. Believes mutants must defend themselves by any means, and has clashed with Xavier for decades over that question. Controls metal with terrifying precision.

lore.title: Nick Fury
lore.text: Director of SHIELD, one-eyed spymaster who has run covert operations across the globe for decades. Maintains a web of secret files, backup plans, and allies, and rarely trusts anyone completely, the Avengers included.

lore.title: Thor
lore.text: Prince of Asgard and wielder of Mjolnir, the hammer only the worthy can lift. Son of Odin and defender of the Nine Realms, he serves as a frequent Avenger. Lightning, thunder, and the Bifrost are his tools.

lore.title: Black Panther
lore.text: T'Challa, king of Wakanda and wearer of the vibranium suit. A brilliant scientist and combat strategist who balances his nation's isolation against a wish to share its technology with a suffering world.
